bibliographic.title: Never After
bibliographic.author: kaylynx
bibliographic.description:
Explore a surreal, ever-shifting park where laughter echoes, shadows move, and the line between imagination and reality blurs. Your choices shape your emotional path: cling to comfort, defy the darkness, or confront your fears. Each decision leaves a mark, and every loop offers new perspectives, hidden details, and subtle shifts in the park’s eerie landscape.

  • Genre: Narrative, psychological exploration, surreal adventure
  • Themes: Trauma, grief, childhood, imagination
  • Playtime: 15-20 minutes per loop, with multiple endings
  • Features:
    • Replayable loops with evolving park environments
    • Branching choices affecting endings and narrative details
    • Subtle visual and textual variations reflecting past choices
